title: Larkspur Fee Schedule Clause: Application Fee Due on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Clause.** The standard application fee due on a Mortgage Loan File is the program's application fee of the program the file is in, in full, with no discount and no offset. The fee due is worked out at the moment of collection from the application fee that the Larkspur program fee schedule lists for the program the file is in at that moment.

**How the fee due is put together.** The rate applied to the program fee is applied first; the dollar amounts taken off are then taken off that rated fee one after another, the result is never less than zero, and it is rounded to the cent at the end. In the standard fee due the program fee is taken in full and nothing is taken off.

## Standard fee due by program

| Program | Program application fee | Standard fee due |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 300.00 USD | 300.00 USD |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 450.00 USD | 450.00 USD |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 450.00 USD | 450.00 USD |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 495.00 USD | 495.00 USD |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 695.00 USD | 695.00 USD |

Programs whose schedule lists an application fee of 0.00 charge none.

## Which program's fee?

The program the file is in at the moment of collection. A hypothetical file moved from the Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed program to the Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed program before the fee is collected is worked out from 495.00 USD, the fee of the program it is in when the fee is collected.
